title: CIA offer to head an ELF research department, brought by Bob Beck

tellings.quote: had been approached by the CIA to head up a ELF research uh department basically.

plain: Sometime between 1977 and 1979, at the house of Andrija Puharich, a doctor who researched the paranormal, Bob Beck is said to have brought word of a CIA offer to head a research department on ELF, short for extremely low frequency radio waves. A researcher on the show, who is not named, tells it from Puharich's own handwritten notes on legal pads. If true, it would mean the CIA was recruiting people from Puharich's circle for this kind of research.
